name: first-five-rig-parity
description: Creates actual R6 and R15 avatars through the official Players API, assigns each to the real isolated Player.Character, checks native Humanoid.RigType/anatomy and all first-five equipment geometry, weld safety, hand-local bounds/orientation during idle, observed shoulder motion and recovery. LoadCharacterAsync restores a normal avatar after each rig and verifies saved fist/old fixture disposal. No metadata-only rig substitution.

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local G=require(RS.GameConfig)
local B=require(RS.FistVisualBuilder)
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
local remote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local firstNames={'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
local function definition(name) for _,d in ipairs(G.AllFists()) do if d.name==name then return d end end error('missing definition '..name) end
local function untilReady(callback,message,seconds)
 local deadline=os.clock()+(seconds or 5)
 repeat local result=callback() if result then return result end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline
 error(message)
end
local function visible(object)
 local node=object
 while node and node~=p.PlayerGui do
  if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end
  if node:IsA('ScreenGui') and not node.Enabled then return false end
  node=node.Parent
 end
 return object:IsDescendantOf(p.PlayerGui)
end
local function catalogModels(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
  if d:IsA('Model') and d:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true and d:FindFirstChild('Catalog Closed Palm') then table.insert(result,d) end
 end
 return result
end
local function parts(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then assert(not result[d.Name],'duplicate part '..d.Name) result[d.Name]=d end end
 return result
end
local function closeVector(actual,expected,epsilon) return (actual-expected).Magnitude<=(epsilon or .003) end
local function colorNear(a,b) return math.max(math.abs(a.R-b.R),math.abs(a.G-b.G),math.abs(a.B-b.B))<=1/255 end
local function actualBounds(root,frame)
 local low=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)
 local high=Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
 for _,part in pairs(parts(root)) do
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local corner=frame:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)*.5))
   low=Vector3.new(math.min(low.X,corner.X),math.min(low.Y,corner.Y),math.min(low.Z,corner.Z))
   high=Vector3.new(math.max(high.X,corner.X),math.max(high.Y,corner.Y),math.max(high.Z,corner.Z))
  end end end
 end
 return low,high
end

  if d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then
   assert(not preview and d.ClassName=='WeldConstraint' and d.Enabled==true,'unapproved visual weld')
   local first,second=d.Part0,d.Part1
   local valid=hand and first and second and ((first:IsA('BasePart') and first:IsDescendantOf(model) and second==hand) or (second:IsA('BasePart') and second:IsDescendantOf(model) and first==hand))
   assert(valid,'wrong wrist weld endpoints')
  else
   assert(not d:IsA('Constraint'),'unapproved visual constraint '..d.ClassName)
  end
  if preview then
   assert(not d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and not d:IsA('Trail') and not d:IsA('Beam') and not d:IsA('Light') and not d:IsA('Highlight'),'effect/physics in preview '..d.ClassName)

 local basePalm
 for _,part in ipairs(spec.parts) do if part.name=='Catalog Closed Palm' then basePalm=part end end
 local scale=palm.Size.X/basePalm.size.X
 assert(scale>0,'invalid uniform scale')

  local part=assert(all[expected.name],'missing '..expected.name)

  local connected=false
  for _,weld in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do if weld:IsA('WeldConstraint') then
   weldCount+=1 assert((weld.Part0==part and weld.Part1==hand) or (weld.Part1==part and weld.Part0==hand),'wrong wrist weld endpoints') connected=true

  assert(connected and not part.Anchored,'catalog part not bound to hand '..part.Name)

local function verifyRig(character,expectedRig,requireNativeShoulder)
 assert(character and character:IsA('Model'),'actual character model unavailable')
 local humanoid=assert(character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'),'actual Humanoid unavailable')
 assert(expectedRig=='R6' or expectedRig=='R15','unsupported rig expectation')
 assert(humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType[expectedRig],'actual Humanoid.RigType mismatch '..expectedRig)
 assert(humanoid.Health>0,'fixture Humanoid is dead')
 local handName=expectedRig=='R6' and 'Right Arm' or 'RightHand'
 local torsoName=expectedRig=='R6' and 'Torso' or 'UpperTorso'
 local upperName=expectedRig=='R6' and 'Right Arm' or 'RightUpperArm'
 local hand=assert(character:FindFirstChild(handName),'actual rig hand unavailable '..handName)
 local torso=assert(character:FindFirstChild(torsoName),'actual rig torso unavailable '..torsoName)
 local upper=assert(character:FindFirstChild(upperName),'actual rig upper arm unavailable '..upperName)
 local rootPart=assert(character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'),'actual root unavailable')
 for _,part in ipairs({hand,torso,upper,rootPart}) do
  assert(part:IsA('BasePart') and not part.Anchored,'invalid or anchored actual rig part '..part.Name)
 end
 local shoulder
 for _,joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
  local endpoints=false
  if joint:IsA('Motor6D') then
   endpoints=joint.Part0==torso and joint.Part1==upper
  elseif joint:IsA('AnimationConstraint') then
   local first,second=joint.Attachment0,joint.Attachment1
   endpoints=first and second and first:IsA('Attachment') and second:IsA('Attachment') and first.Parent==torso and second.Parent==upper
  end
  if endpoints then shoulder=joint break end
 end
 if requireNativeShoulder~=false then assert(shoulder and shoulder.Enabled==true,'native shoulder joint missing or disabled') end
 return {rig=humanoid.RigType.Name,hand=hand.Name,torso=torso.Name,shoulder=shoulder and shoulder.Name or nil,shoulderClass=shoulder and shoulder.ClassName or nil},shoulder
end
local function awaitRigReady(character,expectedRig,requireNativeShoulder)
 local deadline=os.clock()+8
 local lastError='no rig observation'
 repeat
  local ok,report,shoulder=pcall(verifyRig,character,expectedRig,requireNativeShoulder)
  if ok then return report,shoulder end
  lastError=tostring(report)
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
 error('actual rig did not become ready: '..lastError)
end
local function verifyRecoveredTransform(shoulder)
 assert(shoulder and shoulder.Parent and shoulder.Enabled==true,'native shoulder disappeared or disabled before recovery')
 local transform=shoulder.Transform
 local x,y,z=transform:ToOrientation()
 local angle=math.max(math.abs(x),math.abs(y),math.abs(z))
 local offset=transform.Position.Magnitude
 assert(angle<=.001 and offset<=.001,string.format('actual shoulder was not neutral at punch release: angle=%.6f offset=%.6f',angle,offset))
 return {angle=angle,offset=offset,actualTransformRecovered=true,completionFrame=true}
end
local function observeRecoveryHandoff(probe,shoulder,active,phase,sequence)
 if active==true then
  assert(sequence==probe.sequence and not probe.completionObserved,'unexpected punch sequence during recovery observation')
  probe.activeObserved=true probe.lastActive=true
  return nil
 end
 if not probe.activeObserved then
  assert(not (sequence==probe.sequence and phase=='Idle'),'punch completion first observed without an active frame')
  return nil
 end
 if probe.lastActive then
  probe.lastActive=false probe.completionObserved=true
  assert(active==false and phase=='Idle' and sequence==probe.sequence,'punch release sequence or phase mismatch')
  local report=verifyRecoveredTransform(shoulder)
  report.punchSequence=sequence
  return report
 end
 -- Later Animator frames cannot replace a failed or missed release-frame sample.
 return nil
end
